title: Night Serial (original keygen loop, A minor)

module.structure: INTRO(pos0, plays once) | A1 A2 BREAK A1 C1 C2 (loop body, pos1-6) -> back to pos1

sources.sample_synthesis: src/make_samples.py (seeded NumPy synthesis, no third-party audio)
sources.composition: src/compose.py (original melodies, progressions, drum and FX patterns)
sources.batch: src/compose_batch.json (exact FT2 call list used to build the module)

verification.sample_data: all 12 instruments decode (XM delta coding) to exactly the generated WAV (src/verify_xm.py: ALL OK)
verification.clipping: 0 full-scale samples in the preview render; peak -1.97 dBFS, RMS -17.9 dBFS
verification.loop_seam: C2 -> A1 join: largest sample step within +-1 ms is 0.9x the local median step (no click)
verification.other_joins: all other pattern joins are <= 3.5x the local median step; the largest ones are the designed kick/crash attacks on downbeats, not cut-off tones (sustained voices are released or faded before each join)

limitations: Verified by analysis (spectra, levels, seam metrics, file parsing); the render was not auditioned by ear.
